newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds stall in neutral, cap at 110-22.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds stall in neutral, cap at 110-22.

text.p: Technical indicators on U.S. T-bond charts are broadly neutral and offer dealers few clues as to the direction of the market ahead of the crucial FOMC meeting next Tuesday, technical analysts said on Thursday.

"Fundamentally there's a case for an upside break-out, but we're just not getting any confirmation from techncials -- we're continuing to stab higher, but we're not making any progress," said HSBC Securities vice-President Bill Westgate.

By 0954 GMT June T-bonds were down 4/32 at 110-01. On Tuesday, the contract spiked higher intraday, but later faltered to close below the previous day's low completing a key intra-day reversal, usually interpreted as bearish.
But Westgate, was slightly more optimistic. He said the resilience of the T-bond market to the latest fall in the dollar suggested a degree of bullishness.
"To have been able to have that kind of bearish development is a tesimony to the market's bullishness," he said.
The dollar slipped to its lowest levels against the yen since January overnight before edging up to trade at 115.91/116.01 by 0954 GMT.
Westgate put initial support at 109-22, then 109-18. Charts show the market hit a daily low of 109-22 on May 14 and May 6.
On the upside, initial resistance comes in at 110-10 then 110-20, which the market has only managed to pierce once intra-day in recent weeks on Tuesday.
Above there, it will bump into a further barrier at 110-30 to 111-00 before the 111-06 level -- the 50 percent retracement of the major move down from 116-00 to 106-12.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, said the U.S. market was very vulnerable to a technical shock.

"The market is very much struggling with 110-12," he said, adding this was a major retracement level. Although that had been recently breached on an intraday basis he said it was still giving T-bonds trouble.
By 1000 GMT, September Eurodollars were unchanged at 93.905.
